QA-24283 is a PASS, with a data flag. The Sum row has Pin Saves "–" (treated as 0), Comments 670 and Engagements 670, so the sum identity holds. The Average row reads 0 / – / 0, which is consistent, and all 200 rendered rows match per post.

- **Date range:** the default week (Oct 18–24, 2026) has no Pinterest posts for Sephora, so I evaluated Jun 11, 2024 – Jun 10, 2025 (62,031 posts), the same range as the 2026-10-20 run.
- **Pin Saves:** it is "–" on every pin, so the identity only holds because Engagements equals Comments. This is flagged in the report as a possible collection gap, not a math defect.
- **Weak Average check:** 670 engagements over 62,031 pins rounds to 0, so the Average assertion is thin evidence.
- **Dev flakiness:** the first sign-in hit a transient Cognito timeout, and Brand Content hung on a skeleton until one reload. Neither affected the assertions.
- **Bugs:** none open or linked; no bugs filed.

The report is at `results/2026-10-26/QA-24283-report.md`, with screenshots under `.playwright-out/QA-24283/`.
